name: infoschematics
description: The Infoschematic domain model, framework-neutral view model, interactive views, authored examples, guidance, and public website.
author: Infoschematics

scripts.build: bun run ki:packages:build && bun run --cwd apps/site build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules && bun run ki:packages:clean && bun run --cwd apps/site clean
scripts.ki:check: bun run ki:packages:build && bun run ki:verify:visual-tokens && bun run test && bun run ki:verify:typecheck && bun run ki:verify:depcruise && bun run --cwd apps/site build
scripts.ki:dev: bun run ki:packages:build && bun run --cwd apps/site dev
scripts.ki:packages:build: bun run ki:packages:check-versions && bun run --cwd packages/domain-model build && bun run --cwd packages/domain-core build && bun run --cwd packages/view-model build && bun run --cwd packages/render-svg build && bun run --cwd packages/view-canvas build && bun run --cwd packages/view-present build && bun run --cwd packages/view-studio build
scripts.ki:packages:clean: bun run --cwd packages/domain-model clean && bun run --cwd packages/domain-core clean && bun run --cwd packages/view-model clean && bun run --cwd packages/render-svg clean && bun run --cwd packages/view-canvas clean && bun run --cwd packages/view-present clean && bun run --cwd packages/view-studio clean
scripts.ki:release:verify: bun run ki:packages:build && bun run ki:packages:pack-smoke
scripts.ki:verify:depcruise: depcruise packages/domain-model/src packages/domain-core/src packages/view-model/src packages/view-canvas/src packages/view-present/src packages/view-studio/src packages/render-svg/src examples/is-blank/src examples/is-infoschematics/src examples/is-system/src apps/site/src
scripts.ki:verify:typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain-model && tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain-core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/view-model && tsc --noEmit -p packages/view-canvas && tsc --noEmit -p packages/view-present && tsc --noEmit -p packages/view-studio && tsc --noEmit -p packages/render-svg && tsc --noEmit -p examples/is-blank && tsc --noEmit -p examples/is-infoschematics && tsc --noEmit -p examples/is-system && tsc --noEmit -p apps/site
